docs.text: (Kenny) Chee Kim, Gan | 顏子鈞 I am an incoming Ph.D student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Southern California (USC). I currently serve as a research assistant at Academia Sinica, working with Dr. Jun-Cheng chen on topics related on Generative Video Processing/Restoration & World Model. I earned my B.S and M.S from National Taiwan Univeristy (NTU) in Electrical Engineering, and I was fortunate to worked with Prof. Jian-Jiun Ding on Image/Video Signal Processing. Research Interests My research interests span from low-level (image/video signal processing, computer vision) to high-level (computational imaging, generative AI) vision tasks. Hobbies I enjoy reading, coffee, hiking, basketball, watching animes when I am free. Experiences I gained valuable industry experiences at Novatek, MediaTek, and MobileDrive. Novatek (full-time): R&D AI-based and handcraft-based image/video signal processing algorithms for camera SoC. Modules designed includes HDR, noise reduction, motion detection. MediaTek (internship): Accelerate CNNs, working on codec standards like H.265/H.266 including deblocking filter. Mobiledrive (internship): Integrate multi-threaded software architecture for ADAS services, including Bird-Eye-View 3D Object Detection and Tracking. Contact Email : gankenny26@gmail.com or kenny_gan@citi.sinica.edu.tw LinkedIn : LinkedIn News (03/25/2026) I have been accepted to USC ECE Ph.D. Publication Exploiting Attention-to-Motion via Transformer for Versatile Video Frame Interpolation ( GitHub ) Chee Kim Gan , Jian-Jiun Ding, Chang-Yu Hsieh, De-Yan Lu ICASSP 2025 Adaptive face detection algorithm in blurring scenarios Yi-Wei Tsai, Chee Kim Gan , Jian-Jiun Ding IWAIT 2025 Article A Tutorial for Diffusion Model in 2023 A comprehensive review of theory, architectures, applications, and video generation of the Diffusion Models (up to June 2023) Last updated: 2026/03/29
